items.title: First public macOS kernel memory corruption exploit on Apple M5
items.raw_content:
Hacker News score: 464 points, 130 comments | linked site: blog.calif.io | submitted by quadrige

Article description: Apple spent five years building hardware and software to make memory corruption exploits dramatically harder. Our engineers, working together with Mythos Preview, built a working exploit in five days.
items.title_zh: Apple M5 上首个公开的 macOS 内核内存破坏漏洞利用
items.summary: Calif engineers, working with Mythos Preview, built a working macOS kernel memory corruption exploit for Apple's M5 in five days, after Apple spent five years hardening against such attacks. The Hacker News post drew 464 points and 130 comments.

items.title: Unitree GD01: China's $537k rideable transformer robot is now in production
items.raw_content:
Hacker News score: 103 points, 80 comments | linked site: gagadget.com | submitted by rguiscard

Article description: Unitree's GD01 is the world's first mass-produced manned mech suit — a 500kg bipedal/quadrupedal machine that you actually ride. No US or UK release date in sight.
items.title_zh: 宇树 GD01：中国售价 53.7 万美元的可骑乘变形机器人已投产
items.summary: Hacker News discussion (103 points, 80 comments) of a report that Unitree's GD01, described as the world's first mass-produced manned mech suit, a 500kg bipedal/quadrupedal rideable machine, is now in production with no US or UK release date in sight.

items.summary: CNBC reports Waymo issued a voluntary recall of about 3,800 robotaxis to fix software that could let the vehicles drive into flooded roadways; 220 points and 214 comments on Hacker News.

items.title: The OpenAI Deployment Company
items.title_zh: OpenAI部署公司（The OpenAI Deployment Company）
items.summary: OpenAI announced a new venture called the OpenAI Deployment Company on its own site; the Hacker News submission drew 42 points and 33 comments, and the source data includes no article description.

items.title: Show HN: Statewright – Visual state machines that make AI agents reliable
items.title_zh: Show HN：Statewright——让 AI 智能体可靠的可视化状态机
items.summary: A Show HN project by a 20-year engineer that constrains coding agents with formal state machines, giving each state its own tools, iteration count and valid transitions so 13-20B models can attack real SWE-bench problems. 126 points, 59 comments.

items.title: New Claude Code programmatic usage restrictions
items.title_zh: Claude Code 程序化调用的新用量限制
items.summary: Hacker News link (52 points, 42 comments) to a post explaining that from June 15 paid Claude plans can claim a dedicated monthly credit covering the Claude Agent SDK, `claude -p`, Claude Code GitHub Actions and third-party Agent SDK apps.

items.title: Bitcoin trader recovers wallet with help of Claude
items.title_zh: 比特币交易者借助 Claude 找回钱包
items.summary: Hacker News discussion (332 points, 175 comments) of a Tom's Hardware report about a Bitcoin trader who recovered a wallet with the help of Claude. The article notes that the user apparently changed the password while “stoned.”

items.title: Show HN: Watch a neural net learn to play Snake
items.title_zh: Show HN：看神经网络学会玩贪吃蛇
items.summary: An in-browser PPO training demo that lets visitors watch a neural network learn to play Snake, built with tinygrad's TinyJit compiling to WebGPU kernels and requiring WebGPU. The Hacker News submission drew 205 points and 47 comments.

items.title: Show HN: A nibble-oriented CPU in Verilog to build a scientific calculator
items.title_zh: Show HN：用 Verilog 实现面向半字节的 CPU，以此打造科学计算器
items.summary: Show HN project building a custom nibble-oriented, Harvard-architecture CPU in Verilog with CORDIC trigonometry, a Python assembler and a Qt/Verilator toolchain to recreate an HP-style scientific calculator; 119 points.

items.title: Fisker went bankrupt and owners built an open source car company from the ashes
items.title_zh: Fisker 破产后，车主从废墟中建起一家开源汽车公司
items.summary: Hacker News discussion (178 points, 65 comments) of an Electrek story on how, after Fisker's bankruptcy orphaned 11,000 Ocean EVs, a 4,000-member community reverse-engineered the software and kept the cars alive.

items.title: Someone Shared a Real Monet Painting as AI and Asked for Critiques
items.title_zh: 有人把莫奈真迹当作 AI 作品发布并求点评
items.summary: Hacker News discussion (58 points, 68 comments) of a PetaPixel story about someone who shared a real Monet painting while presenting it as AI-generated and then asked for critiques.

items.title: At least 25 Flock cameras have been destroyed in five states since April 2025
items.title_zh: 自 2025 年 4 月以来，至少 25 台 Flock 摄像头在五个州被毁
items.summary: A report counts at least 25 Flock license plate cameras destroyed in five states since April 2025, from California to Tennessee, with one man charged for destroying 13 of them. Hacker News: 443 points, 326 comments.

items.title: Mozilla to UK regulators: VPNs are essential privacy and security tools
items.title_zh: Mozilla 向英国监管机构表态：VPN 是必不可少的隐私与安全工具
items.summary: Mozilla's policy blog argues that VPNs are essential privacy and security tools and should not be undermined, responding to a UK Department for Science, Innovation and Technology consultation on preparing young people for digital technologies. Hacker News: 808 points, 356 comments.

items.title: MacBook Neo Deep Dive: Benchmarks, Wafer Economics, and the 8GB Gamble
items.title_zh: MacBook Neo 深度解析：跑分、晶圆经济与 8GB 豪赌
items.summary: Front-page Hacker News discussion (337 points, 411 comments) of a deep dive into Apple's $699 MacBook Neo, which uses the iPhone 16 Pro's A18 Pro chip and scores 3,569 single-core in Geekbench 6, between M3 and M4.

items.title: New arXiv policy: 1-year ban for hallucinated references
items.title_zh: arXiv 新政策：伪造参考文献将被禁投一年
items.summary: Hacker News discussion (659 points, 230 comments) of a new arXiv policy imposing a one-year ban for hallucinated references, enforcing its code of conduct that signing as an author means taking responsibility for all contents, however generated.

items.title: Zerostack – A Unix-inspired coding agent written in pure Rust
items.title_zh: Zerostack：用纯 Rust 编写的 Unix 风格编码智能体
items.summary: Front-page Hacker News discussion (575 points, 308 comments) of Zerostack 1.0.0, a Unix-inspired coding agent written in pure Rust and published on crates.io, the Rust package registry.

items.title: Show HN: TikTok but for scientific papers
items.title_zh: Show HN：论文界的TikTok
items.summary: A Show HN project presents a quiet, black-and-white research feed for academic papers, with on-device AI, quizzes and discussion. The Hacker News submission drew 200 points and 79 comments.

items.title: California Mayor Resigns, Admitting to Being an Agent for China
items.title_zh: 加州市长辞职，承认充当中国政府代理人
items.summary: Time reports that Eileen Wang resigned as mayor of Arcadia, California, as U.S. officials say she will plead guilty to acting as an agent for the Chinese government. Hacker News: 21 points, 0 comments.

items.title: EU to crack down on TikTok, Instagram's 'addictive design' targeting kids
items.title_zh: 欧盟将整治 TikTok、Instagram 针对儿童的“成瘾性设计”
items.summary: CNBC reports the EU is investigating platforms that let children go down rabbit holes of harmful content, according to Commission President Ursula von der Leyen. Hacker News: 516 points, 464 comments.

items.title: Show HN: GridTravel – A community based travel app for users to share routes
items.title_zh: Show HN：GridTravel——由用户分享路线的社区旅行应用
items.summary: Hacker News Show HN post (62 points, 41 comments) for GridTravel, a free iOS app from three 21-year-old cofounders that lets travelers create, follow and share community-built routes with turn-by-turn navigation, built on Mapbox, Supabase and Swift.

items.title: DeepSeek V4: The Open-Source Model Frontier Labs Feared
items.title_zh: DeepSeek V4：让前沿实验室忌惮的开源模型
items.summary: Report that DeepSeek V4 ships under the MIT license at $0.30 per million output tokens, 83x cheaper than Claude Opus 4.7, while scoring 80.6% on SWE-bench Verified. Hacker News: 85 points, 31 comments.

items.title: DeepSeek-V4-Flash means LLM steering is interesting again
items.title_zh: DeepSeek-V4-Flash 让 LLM 引导（steering）重新变得有趣
items.summary: Hacker News discussion (280 points, 76 comments) of an essay arguing that DeepSeek-V4-Flash makes activation steering — directly manipulating model activations to guide outputs — interesting again, revisiting ideas popularized by Golden Gate Claude.

items.title: How to buy cheap Claude tokens in China
items.title_zh: 在中国如何买到便宜的 Claude token
items.summary: ChinaTalk article by Zilan Qian, a research associate at the Oxford China Policy Lab, on how users in China can buy cheap Claude tokens. Hacker News discussion: 38 points, 10 comments.

items.title: FULU-Foundation/OrcaSlicer-bambulab
items.title_zh: FULU-Foundation/OrcaSlicer-bambulab
items.summary: A C++ repository trending on GitHub as of May 11, 2026, with 7,203 stars and 5,159 forks, ranked in the daily trending list. The provided data includes no project description beyond the repository name.

items.title: Fractal-Compute-Orchestrations/FractalCore
items.title_zh: FractalCore：Fractal 的后端编排中枢
items.summary: FractalCore is the central nervous system and backend orchestrator for Fractal, handling multi-tenant task scheduling, real-time TFLOPs budgeting and federated weight aggregation using FedAvg. The Python repository has 3,772 stars and topics including federated learning and IoT.

items.title: google-deepmind/science-skills
items.title_zh: google-deepmind/science-skills：加速智能体化科研工作流
items.summary: Google DeepMind releases science skills that ground agentic scientific workflows in AlphaGenome, AFDB, UniProt and more than 30 other databases and tools, aiming for better grounding and higher token efficiency; 3,332 GitHub stars.

items.title: zLanqing/codex-claude-academic-skills
items.title_zh: zLanqing/codex-claude-academic-skills：面向中文科研用户的三个技能
items.summary: A Python repository bundling three skills for Chinese-speaking researchers: paper reading reports with slide and Word generation, research writing and peer-review replies, and MATLAB/Python scientific computing with journal-quality figures. It has 5,304 stars and 279 forks.

items.title: vercel-labs/zerolang
items.title_zh: vercel-labs/zerolang：为智能体而生的编程语言
items.summary: Vercel Labs repository pitching zerolang as the programming language for agents, written in C, with 5,386 stars and 342 forks on GitHub Trending for May 15.

items.title: feicaiclub/video-spec-builder
items.title_zh: video-spec-builder：把视频想法变成精确到秒的分镜脚本
items.summary: GitHub Trending repository (1,043 stars, JavaScript) installed as a skill for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex that turns a rough video idea into a shot-by-shot video-spec.md script for HyperFrames to render.

items.title: Nieobie/game-icon-pack
items.title_zh: Nieobie/game-icon-pack：800+ 圆角风格图标
items.summary: An icon pack of more than 800 rounded-style game icons in SVG, tagged for game assets and rounded corners; the JavaScript repository has 711 GitHub stars and 39 forks.

items.title: seakee/CPA-Manager-Plus
items.title_zh: seakee/CPA-Manager-Plus：自托管 CPA 管理面板与 AI 网关可观测性仪表盘
items.summary: A self-hosted management panel for CPA / CLIProxyAPI plus an observability dashboard for AI gateway requests, usage, cost, quota, failures and account health. 3,953 GitHub stars, written in Go.

items.title: ronaldo-avalos/Maya
items.title_zh: ronaldo-avalos/Maya：给 iPhone 录屏加上精美机身外框
items.summary: A Swift macOS app that wraps iPhone screen recordings in device frames, adds cinematic zoom moments and exports ready-to-share videos; 1,067 GitHub stars and 61 forks.

items.title: A^2RD: Agentic Autoregressive Diffusion for Long Video Consistency
items.title_zh: A^2RD：面向长视频一致性的智能体自回归扩散
items.summary: Google's A^2RD treats long-video generation as a closed loop of retrieve, synthesize, refine and update, using multimodal video memory, adaptive segment generation and hierarchical test-time self-improvement to fight semantic drift over long horizons. 16 Hugging Face upvotes.

items.title: MemPrivacy: Privacy-Preserving Personalized Memory Management for Edge-Cloud Agents
items.title_zh: MemPrivacy：面向端云智能体的隐私保护个性化记忆管理
items.summary: MemPrivacy replaces privacy-sensitive spans on the edge device with type-aware placeholders before cloud-side memory processing, then restores them locally; it caps utility loss at 1.6% across memory systems and drew 147 Hugging Face upvotes.

items.title: Self-Distilled Agentic Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 自蒸馏的智能体强化学习
items.summary: SDAR treats on-policy self-distillation as a gated auxiliary objective to reinforcement learning for multi-turn agents, improving over GRPO by 9.4 points on ALFWorld, 7.0 on Search-QA and 10.2 on WebShop accuracy.

items.title: Anisotropic Modality Align
items.title_zh: 各向异性模态对齐
items.summary: This work revisits the modality gap in multimodal contrastive models, finding representations already share compatible dominant semantic geometry and that an anisotropic correction, not a global shift, is what blocks reliable modality interchange. 25 Hugging Face upvotes; code released.

items.title: Geometry Conflict: Explaining and Controlling Forgetting in LLM Continual Post-Training
items.title_zh: Geometry Conflict：解释并控制 LLM 持续后训练中的遗忘
items.summary: Hong Kong Polytechnic University researchers find that forgetting in continual post-training arises when task-induced covariance geometry misaligns with the evolving model state, and propose Geometry-Conflict Wasserstein Merging (GCWM), a data-free update-integration method evaluated on Qwen3 models from 0.6B to 14B.

items.title: PreScam: A Benchmark for Predicting Scam Progression from Early Conversations
items.title_zh: PreScam：从早期对话预测诈骗进程的基准
items.summary: Notre Dame benchmark built from 177,989 user-submitted reports that structures 11,573 conversational scam cases along a kill chain; supervised encoders beat zero-shot LLMs at predicting real-time scam termination.

items.title: Discovering Reinforcement Learning Interfaces with Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 用大语言模型发现强化学习接口
items.summary: Lossfunk's LIMEN uses an LLM-guided evolutionary loop to synthesize complete RL task interfaces - observation mappings and reward functions as executable programs - refining candidates with policy-training feedback on gridworld and continuous-control tasks. One Hugging Face upvote; an 11-star repo.

items.title: PaperFit: Vision-in-the-Loop Typesetting Optimization for Scientific Documents
items.title_zh: PaperFit：面向科研文档的视觉闭环排版优化
items.summary: OpenDataLab's PaperFit is a vision-in-the-loop agent that renders LaTeX pages, diagnoses layout defects and applies constrained source-level repairs, formalized as Visual Typesetting Optimization. It ships with PaperFit-Bench, 200 papers across 10 venue templates and 13 defect types (33 upvotes).

items.title: Missing Old Logits in Asynchronous Agentic RL: Semantic Mismatch and Repair Methods for Off-Policy Correction
items.title_zh: 异步智能体强化学习中缺失的旧 logits：语义错配与离策略修正方法
items.summary: JD researchers show why PPO-style off-policy correction breaks in asynchronous agentic RL when historical training-side logits are lost, and compare three exact old-logit acquisition strategies against a revised PPO-EWMA approximation. 15 Hugging Face upvotes.

items.title: Retrieval is Cheap, Show Me the Code: Executable Multi-Hop Reasoning for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
items.title_zh: 检索很便宜，给我看代码：面向 RAG 的可执行多跳推理
items.summary: UIUC's PyRAG reformulates multi-hop RAG as synthesizing and executing Python programs over retrieval and QA tools, exposing intermediate states and enabling compiler-grounded self-repair without extra training. It outperforms strong baselines on five QA benchmarks; 8 upvotes.

items.title: WildClawBench: A Benchmark for Real-World, Long-Horizon Agent Evaluation
items.title_zh: WildClawBench：面向真实世界长程任务的智能体评测基准
items.summary: Intern Large Models benchmark of 60 human-authored, bilingual, multimodal agent tasks run inside real CLI harnesses such as Claude Code and Codex; the best model, Claude Opus 4.7, reaches only 62.2%.
